main_text.l: Capita doctrinæ de Peccato originali de quibus
te, perinde ac si coram sermone res age-
vti spero, tua, velut oculis meis obuer-

page.notes: The initial letter is a large woodcut "I" (rendered as "L" in the printed form of the first word, read here as LICEAT). The first word of the body is printed with the woodcut initial; the letter is partly obscured by the ornament. The title block is set in italic and roman capitals as printed.
